comments.title: Comments
comments.empty: No comments yet — write the first one!

embed.loginBlocked: Your browser blocks signing in inside the embedded widget.
embed.notRegisteredText: The comment widget is not registered for this domain or content type. Operators can register domains in the dashboard under "Embed sites".

guest.rateLimited: Too many comments in a short time. Please try again in a moment.

embedAdmin.title: Embed sites
embedAdmin.subtitle: Registered embedder domains of the comment widget: only these websites may embed the widget (frame-ancestors CSP). Changes apply immediately.
embedAdmin.createdHint: The domain is live right away — the widget can be embedded there from now on.
embedAdmin.createFailedHint: Most likely causes: the domain is already registered, or it was not given as a plain hostname (no https://, no path).
embedAdmin.disabledHint: Existing embeds on this domain stop showing comments immediately.
embedAdmin.updateFailedHint: The switch is back where it was. Reload the page and try again.
embedAdmin.deleteFailedHint: The domain is still registered. Reload the page and try again.
embedAdmin.confirmDeleteText: {host} will no longer be allowed to embed the widget. This takes effect immediately.
embedAdmin.hostHelp: Canonical hostname of the embedding page, lowercase, without https:// — e.g. blog.customer.com
embedAdmin.label: Display name (optional)
embedAdmin.targetTypesHelp: Comma-separated, e.g. blog, page — empty = all content types allowed.

disabled.title: Comments disabled
disabled.text: New comments are currently disabled. Existing comments stay visible.
disabled.maintenanceText: New comments are paused during maintenance. Existing comments stay visible.
disabled.maintenanceToast: Maintenance mode — commenting is temporarily locked.
disabled.draftKeptHint: Your text stays in the box — you can send it later.

moderation.bulkPartialHint: The remaining comments are unchanged. The selection was cleared — find them in the refreshed list and try again there.
moderation.bulkFailedHint: No comment was changed. Check your connection and try again.
moderation.actionFailedHint: Nothing was changed. Reload the list and try again.
moderation.assistFailedHint: The assessment is advisory only — you can hide or keep the comment without it.
moderation.hiddenHint: The open reports for this comment are resolved along with it.
moderation.blockedHint: Existing comments stay visible — hide them individually if needed.

form.error: The comment could not be saved.
form.errorHint: Your text is still in the box. Check your connection and send it again.

item.voteErrorHint: That is why the count jumped back. Check your connection and vote again.
item.editErrorHint: Your change is still in the box, the comment is unchanged.
item.deleteErrorHint: The comment is still there. Check your connection and try again.

validation.contentRequired: The comment must not be empty
validation.guestNameRequired: Please enter a name (at least 2 characters)
